cover_alt.title:
Product Analyst
or
Data Analyst?
cover_alt.sub: Which one should a fresher aim for?

top.label: Data Analyst
top.head: Answers
points: What happened in the business, and why?
Sales fell in March: which region, which product

bottom.label: Product Analyst
bottom.head: Answers
points: How do people use the app, and what should change?
Where users drop off before paying

top.label: Data Analyst
top.head: Same table, different question
points: Which region sold the most?
SELECT region, SUM(amount) FROM orders GROUP BY region;

bottom.label: Product Analyst
bottom.head: Same table, different question
points: How many orders end up cancelled or returned?
SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status;

top.label: Data Analyst
top.head: Daily tools
points: Excel, SQL
Power BI or Tableau
Some Python (pandas)

bottom.label: Product Analyst
bottom.head: Daily tools
points: SQL, a lot of it
Event tools like Mixpanel or Amplitude
Sheets, some Python

top.label: Data Analyst
top.head: A normal day
points: Refresh the sales dashboard
Answer a manager's quick question
Clean a messy Excel export

bottom.label: Product Analyst
bottom.head: A normal day
points: Check yesterday's sign-up funnel
Size a feature idea with event data
Read an A/B test with the product manager

top.label: Data Analyst
top.head: Interviews ask
points: SQL joins and GROUP BY
Lookups and pivots in Excel
Walk me through your dashboard

bottom.label: Product Analyst
bottom.head: Interviews ask
points: SQL on event tables
How would you measure this feature?
Read this A/B test result

top.label: Data Analyst
top.head: Entry route for freshers
points: Excel + SQL + one BI tool
2-3 dashboard projects on sales or HR data

bottom.label: Product Analyst
bottom.head: Entry route for freshers
points: Strong SQL + product sense
A funnel or retention project on app data

top.label: Data Analyst
top.head: Pick it if you...
points: Like turning messy data into a clear report
Want options in any industry, any city

bottom.label: Product Analyst
bottom.head: Pick it if you...
points: Use apps and wonder why people quit them
Enjoy experiments and arguing about metrics
bottom.line: Easier after 1-2 years as an analyst.
